mode: fixed MIT-reference source contracts; unit mocks and isolated React renderer; no live requests, account writes or phone access

reference.scope: Reference-client behavior, not an exhaustive official APK feature specification

checks: reject unknown options and bad pagination
nested APK entities and known aliases
accessible page-two network retry preserves exact cursors and page-one cards
page-two verification accumulates without resetting page one
narrow dark renderer and native keyboard controls

limits: Named guest app rank/newest and hot-game reads are recorded separately in research/app-user-discovery-live-checks.json. Other categories and authenticated server behavior remain unverified.

Reference game/application utility and category filtering is a compatibility heuristic, not a guarantee of the server's full classification semantics
This report does not claim completion of all APK/application-center functionality
